steps.text: Talk to Timfraku upstairs in his house in Tai Bwo Wannai.
Talk to Timfraku upstairs in his house in Tai Bwo Wannai.
choices: Who me? Oh I'm just a nobody.
Your gratitude is all I deserve.
Well, some gold would be nice.

steps.text: Open your quest journal to sync your current state.
Using your small fishing net, catch atleast 23 raw karambwanji just south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Go to Brimhaven and talk to Lubufu. You have to talk to him multiple times. You'll need to ask him twice about what he does, then talk to him to give him the karambwanji.
choices: I could help collect the bait.
You sound like you could do with the help.
What do you use to catch Karambwan?

steps.text: Get a Vessel from Lubufu by asking what he uses to catch them multiple times. Drop it, and talk to him go get another, then pick up the one you dropped. You can get as many as you want but you need 2 to complete this quest.
choices: What do you use to catch Karambwan?
Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.

steps.text: Drop the vessel, then get another from Lubufu.
Get another Vessel from Lubufu.
choices: Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.

steps.text: Pick up the vessel you dropped.
Use a karambwanji on a karambwan Vessel to fill it.
Go east to Musa point to buy some Karamjan rum from Zembo.
Slice a banana with a knife. You can get a banana from one of the trees in the plantation.
Add banana slices to the karamjan rum to make Karamjan rum with banana slices.
Talk to Tiadeche in east Karamja, near the fairy ring DKP. You can teleport off Karamja; the Karamjan rum with banana will not break.
Use a filled vessel on Tiadeche. Make sure to finish the dialogue with him and accept the karambwan he offers!
Talk to Tiadeche more.
Pickup some seaweed from Karamja's coast.
Get some jogre bones. You can kill the jogres south of Tiadeche.
Pickup the jogre bones.
Kill a monkey to get its corpse, there are plenty of monkeys around Karamja and you will need either magic or range to kill one.
Pickup the monkey corpse.
Talk to Tamayu, he is located north of Shilo Village near the mining sign on the map, after watching him use your tinder box on your jogre bones and pick up the burnt jogre bones.
Use the paste on an iron or better spear.

items.name: Iron spear or better (You will lose the spear)

steps.text: Use an agility potion (4) on Tamayu.
Use a poisoned spear on Tamayu.

items.name: Iron spear or better (kp) (You will lose the spear)

steps.text: Fish raw Karambwan next to Tiadeche with a loaded vessel or buy them from the GE.
Use a pestle and mortar on a karambwanji.
Use the karambwanji paste on the burnt jogre bones.
Use a pestle and mortar on a poison karambwan.
Use the karambwan paste on a iron or better spear.

items.name: Iron spear or better (You will lose the spear)

steps.text: Wait for the bones to burn, then pick them up.
Cook the karambwan for a poison karambwan. Note you may fail this and need to try again.
Use a tinderbox on the jogre bones to set them on fire.
Go on a hunt with Tamayu.
choices: Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan.

steps.text: RIGHT-CLICK use the bones on a fire. You can either make one yourself, or use them on the fire south of Tai Bwo Wannai.
Use your monkey corpse on Tamayu to have him skin it for you.
Use your seaweed on your monkey skin to make a seaweed sandwich.
Talk to Tinsay on Cairn Isle west of Shilo Village, south of fairy ring CKR. Keep talking to him, giving him the items he asks for.
Use the vessel on Tinsay.
Go back to Tiadeche located north of fairy ring DKP and use the crafting manual on him.
Go to Timfraku's house to finish the quest.

Talk to Timfraku to end the quest, the option chosen here does not matter. NOTE: you will need to talk to each of the brothers individually in Tai Bwo Wannai to receive experience rewards as well as the ability to cook karambwans properly.
choices: I'd rather have some gold please.
You know your sons have serious issues...
